verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS virtual mailbox service, so scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no API, no API keys and no scoped tokens, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404. Multi-user mail sharing is a human team-access feature, an adjacent control rather than least-privilege API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
